title: A Construct-Validity Protocol for Geometric Evaluation of Single-Cell Foundation Model Embeddings
description: This paper introduces a construct-validity protocol that tests whether scIB metrics measure what they claim. Four tests expose systematic failures: null-model discrimination (random projections score highly), cross-dimensionality robustness (rankings permute under projection), sign-correctness (46-67% pairwise inversion rates against ground-truth F1), and noise dose-response (bio metrics behave non-monotonically under controlled degradation). The archive contains the manuscript, experiment scripts, raw JSON results from all experiments on CELLxGENE Census, figure generation code, and SHA-256 frozen preregistration documents.
